title: 畜舍通風與熱壓力感測
titleEn: Livestock Housing Ventilation and Heat Stress Sensing
summary: 以「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「換氣量充足但分布短路」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」。畫出「外部環境 → 覆蓋與開口 → 內部負荷 → 循環設備 → 空間感測」並圈出與「熱交換功率」有關的介面。將 U*area*delta 每個變數標到圖上，寫明單位、方向及資料來源。解釋：整體熱傳係數乘面積與適當平均溫差給出熱流率。 再指出這個局部模型無法回答的項目：以固定平均溫差作一階模型，不取代複雜幾何的局部熱場或相變分析。
steps.instructionEn: The case focus is Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing. Draw External environment → Cover and openings → Internal loads → Circulation equipment → Spatial sensing and mark the interfaces relevant to Heat-transfer rate. Place every variable of U*area*delta on the drawing with units, direction and provenance. Explain: Overall transfer coefficient times area and an appropriate mean temperature difference gives heat-transfer rate. Identify what it cannot establish: A fixed mean temperature difference is a first-order model, not a local thermal-field or phase-change solution.

steps.failureEn: Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting; A fixed mean temperature difference is a first-order model, not a local thermal-field or phase-change solution.
steps.check: 提交標註介面圖及變數表；每個變數有單位與假設/來源/量測標籤，並明列「以固定平均溫差作一階模型，不取代複雜幾何的局部熱場或相變分析。」。

steps.title: 單元1｜熱交換功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Heat-transfer rate: Quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」完成定量估算並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete quantitative estimate for Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課焦點「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」的「熱交換功率」採以下合成教學值：U=5 W/(m² K)；area=2 m²；delta=10 K。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 U*area*delta；獨立基準為 100 W。把 U 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 110 W。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing, use synthetic inputs for Heat-transfer rate: U=5 W/(m² K)；area=2 m²；delta=10 K. Check dimensions before evaluating U*area*delta; the independent benchmark is 100 W. Increase U by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 110 W. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: U增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 10 W。以固定平均溫差作一階模型，不取代複雜幾何的局部熱場或相變分析。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 10 W. A fixed mean temperature difference is a first-order model, not a local thermal-field or phase-change solution.
steps.failure: 換氣量充足但分布短路；以固定平均溫差作一階模型，不取代複雜幾何的局部熱場或相變分析。
steps.failureEn: Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting; A fixed mean temperature difference is a first-order model, not a local thermal-field or phase-change solution.
steps.check: 原值重算與 100 W 相符；10%案例與 110 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 100 W at baseline and 110 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（W）？
quiz.explanation: 按 U*area*delta 逐項代入，結果為 100；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into U*area*delta gives 100; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元1｜熱交換功率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Heat-transfer rate: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」設計「熱交換功率」的獨立驗證：獨立量測熱側和冷側流量與進出口溫度，以兩側熱帳交叉驗證。 用空間分區合成資料分開顯熱、潛熱、供水及通風，平均值之外報分布。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing, independently verify Heat-transfer rate: Measure both-side flows and inlet/outlet temperatures; cross-check the two heat accounts. Separate sensible/latent heat, water and ventilation using zonal synthetic data; report distributions as well as means. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「換氣量充足但分布短路」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 換氣量充足但分布短路；以固定平均溫差作一階模型，不取代複雜幾何的局部熱場或相變分析。
steps.failureEn: Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting; A fixed mean temperature difference is a first-order model, not a local thermal-field or phase-change solution.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「以固定平均溫差作一階模型，不取代複雜幾何的局部熱場或相變分析。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state A fixed mean temperature difference is a first-order model, not a local thermal-field or phase-change solution.

只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
optionsEn: Retain raw data and perform: Measure both-side flows and inlet/outlet temperatures; cross-check the two heat accounts.
Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.

quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state A fixed mean temperature difference is a first-order model, not a local thermal-field or phase-change solution.

steps.instruction: 本課焦點「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」的「名義停留時間」採以下合成教學值：volume=0.02 m³；flow=0.001 m³/s。先逐項檢查量綱，再代入 volume/flow；獨立基準為 20 s。把 volume 增加10%，其他輸入保持原值；先預測方向再重算，結果應為 22 s。將數值、單位與是否可外推分欄記錄。
steps.instructionEn: For Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing, use synthetic inputs for Nominal residence time: volume=0.02 m³；flow=0.001 m³/s. Check dimensions before evaluating volume/flow; the independent benchmark is 20 s. Increase volume by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 22 s. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: volume增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 2 s。不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 2 s. This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.failure: 換氣量充足但分布短路；不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.failureEn: Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting; This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.check: 原值重算與 20 s 相符；10%案例與 22 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 20 s at baseline and 22 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（s）？
quiz.explanation: 按 volume/flow 逐項代入，結果為 20；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into volume/flow gives 20; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜名義停留時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Nominal residence time: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」設計「名義停留時間」的獨立驗證：以惰性數位示蹤脈衝畫出出口時間分布，與V/Q比較。 用空間分區合成資料分開顯熱、潛熱、供水及通風，平均值之外報分布。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing, independently verify Nominal residence time: Plot an inert digital tracer response and compare its distribution with V/Q. Separate sensible/latent heat, water and ventilation using zonal synthetic data; report distributions as well as means. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「換氣量充足但分布短路」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 換氣量充足但分布短路；不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.failureEn: Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting; This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：以惰性數位示蹤脈衝畫出出口時間分布，與V/Q比較。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Plot an inert digital tracer response and compare its distribution with V/Q.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。」。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.

steps.title: 單元2｜名義停留時間：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Nominal residence time: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「換氣量充足但分布短路」。以本單元「名義停留時間」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「以惰性數位示蹤脈衝畫出出口時間分布，與V/Q比較。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting. For Nominal residence time, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Plot an inert digital tracer response and compare its distribution with V/Q. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「換氣量充足但分布短路」不是單靠 20 s 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 20 s alone cannot exclude Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 換氣量充足但分布短路；不是最短停留時間；死區、短路與分散需示蹤資料。
steps.failureEn: Adequate total ventilation with short-circuiting; This is not minimum residence time; dead zones, short circuits and dispersion need tracer data.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「畜舍換氣、顯熱與水汽負荷」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Ventilation, sensible heat and moisture in animal housing and retaining failed cases.
